title: Confident wrong answer followed by correct re-check
label: Demo data — synthetic
question: What is the derivative of sin(3x)?
student_answer: The derivative of sin is cos, so it is just cos(3x).

chunks.text: By the chain rule, d/dx[sin(g(x))] = cos(g(x)) * gprime(x). Therefore, d/dx[sin(3x)] = 3*cos(3x).
